measurement: Median of three device-event intervals; one graph repeats one matrix 50 times after warm-up. Weights are warm and reused. Quantization and copies excluded. Sum of isolated timings is not generation time.
hardware: Intel Arc B570, Ryzen 5 5600X, 125 GiB RAM

ordinary_generation_no_profile.flags: Same as shared-overlap 128-token runs, with --expert-profile omitted
ordinary_generation_no_profile.limitation: One diagnostic run; cache placement and output text differ from static-profile runs, so this is not a controlled kernel speed comparison.
